color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no twist applied. Light register: pageBackground #ffffff, bodyText #000000, accent #ee7421 (DayGlo orange). Binary white/black field with single alarm-signal accent.

type-system.twistDescription: Punk typeface collision: Oswald 900 (400/700/900 weights, heading/display/environmental scales) against IBM Plex Mono 400/600 (body/label). Environmental text at 360px/900wt for background texture use. h1 at 72px uppercase, all headings negative-tracked. Both loaded via Google Fonts CDN @import.

motion-system.twistDescription: All easing replaced with steps(1) — no interpolation anywhere. Base 0.15s, fast 0.05s, stagger 0.04s. Custom keyframes: typewriter (character-by-character xerox reveal), flicker (opacity strobe), xeroxReveal (6-step clip-path staircase), bulge (scale stamp-in), stampIn (full opacity snap). Anti-smooth philosophy throughout.

grid-system.twistDescription: Zine collage grid: .zine-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr 1fr } for asymmetric 3-column layout. Paste-up utility classes: .zine-overlap { margin-top: -24px } for stacking overlap, .zine-bleed { margin-left: -32px } for grid-edge breaks, .zine-rotated { transform: rotate(-1.5deg) } for hand-glued misalignment. Container 1440px/22px paddingInline.

spacing-system.twistDescription: 3px base unit (vs standard 4px/8px grid) — all values snapped to 3px multiples. Creates deliberately off-kilter photocopied rhythm: section 105px/87px, footer 60px/99px, button gap 21px, CTA paddingInline 33px, container 96px. Precise but visually irregular.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Instant snap punk: all transitions 0.05s steps(1) — no easing, states flip like a physical switch. Focus ring: 4px dashed outline (safety pin aesthetic). Primary button hover: black→DayGlo orange instant flip. Ghost button hover: transparent→black fill instant inversion. Accent button: DayGlo orange inverts to black/orange. Nothing eases.

nav-system.twistDescription: Ultra-compact 20px sticker nav: zero horizontal padding, Oswald 700 at 0.65rem with 0.12em letter-spacing — reads like a zine masthead stamp. No background, no scroll transition, no dropdown. Maximum compression. Item spacing 24px creates deliberate crowding.
nav-system.checkCFix: JetBrains Mono (from source dark-array) not present in assembled type system (Oswald + IBM Plex Mono). fontFamily changed to 'Oswald', sans-serif — Oswald IS present as ds-font-family-display/heading.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Tone shift to underground music venue + DIY record label collective: Black Market Sessions. Pattern A (Full-Bleed Vinyl/Print Hero), Pattern B (Raw Material Immersion), Pattern C (Utilitarian Transaction Layer). Binary white/black field with DayGlo orange as single alarm-signal per section. Concept_by_video.md generated: 3 video placements — vinyl turntable hero (12s), live session documentation (45s), vinyl pressing operation (20s).

A_colorContrast.notes: navText #000000 (brightness 0) vs navBackground transparent (treated as #ffffff, brightness 255) — maximum contrast. bodyText #000000 vs pageBackground #ffffff — maximum contrast.

B_motionInteractionCoherence.notes: Hover transitions 0.05s vs motion base 0.15s — ratio 3×, well under 5× threshold. Both use steps(1) easing — stylistically unified.

C_navFontAvailability.reason: JetBrains Mono sourced from dark-array's nav.json but not present in torn-press's assembled type system. Oswald (ds-font-family-display) is present and matches the punk sticker aesthetic.
